Name: Prismatic Tools Continued
Author: iargue
Description:
This is a continuation of the Prismatic Tools mode originally made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53820731]stokastic[/url]. They have not updated the mod since 2018, so I'm releasing this version to provide continued updates to the mod.

Knowing mod conflicts:
﻿Return of Immersive Sprinklers/Scarecrows: The mods are poorly coded; I can't fix the issues on my end; that mod will need to be updated to fix the problems.

Key Improvements:
﻿Less usage of harmony patches - should be easier to keep up to date and be more compatible with other mods.
﻿Works seamlessly with automate now.
﻿Uses it's own tilesheet so other mods won't conflict with this mod.
﻿Supports upgrades through Mail Services Framework mod.
Features:

﻿Prismatic Axe: One shots all trees and stumps. Two hits for the large logs.
[list]
[*]Prismatic Pickaxe: One shots all rocks and ores.
[*]Prismatic Hoe: Has 5x7 coverage (almost double that of iridium)
[*]Prismatic Watering Can: Has 5x7 coverage (almost double that of iridium)
[*]Prismatic Sprinkler has 7x7 coverage (Configurable)
[*]Primastic Sprinker can act as a scarecrow and a lamp (Configurable).
[/list]
More updates are planned, please report any bugs and I will get them updated.

Usage:

Prismatic Bars can be created using the Furnace. Requires 1 prismatic shard and 1 coal and will produce 5 Prismatic Bars.
At Farming level 9 you can craft a Prismatic Sprinkler with two Prismatic Bars.
Upgrading tools will cost 5 bars and 100,000 gold.

Downloads.Description:
Fixed item description strings.
Fixed some typo's.
Scarecrow range should dynamically adjust when a nozzler is installed.
Added French and portuguese translations.

Mod should be fully compatible with 1.7 when it releases.
